output.summary: An erect flowering shrub endemic to Western Australia. Its white or pink flowers appear from June to November and remain fresh relatively long after cutting. Its aromatic, citrus-flavoured leaves are used like rosemary in cooking or to flavour oils, sauces and spirits.
output.edibilityNote: The leaves are used like rosemary or infused into oil, stock, sauces, gin and other spirits for citrus flavour.
